note: Claude Code uses the Anthropic API. Model selection is controlled via CLAUDE_CODE_MODEL env var or --model flag. Per-agent model switching requires spawning separate Claude Code instances.

tier-s.rationale: Sonnet has the best code reasoning at the best price point. Opus is the fallback only for exceptionally complex architectural problems.

tier-a.rationale: Validation and spec writing require the same precision as design. Sonnet is the cost-effective sweet spot.

tier-b.rationale: Haiku is ~5x cheaper than Sonnet and handles exploration, domain modeling, and task decomposition reliably. Upgrade to Sonnet only when the domain model exceeds Haiku's context window.

tier-c.rationale: Knowledge agent runs frequently on summarization tasks. Haiku is optimal for throughput. Use Sonnet only when the refactor agent detects structural degradation requiring deep analysis.
